cases.question: 以2026年9月12日为今天，上个月表现最好的5个商品是哪些？
cases.reference_sql: SELECT p.product_name,SUM(oi.quantity) AS quantity FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id=oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') AND o.order_date>='2026-08-01' AND o.order_date<'2026-09-01' GROUP BY p.product_id,p.product_name ORDER BY quantity DESC,p.product_id ASC LIMIT 5

cases.question: 以2026年9月12日为今天，上个月销售额最高的5个商品是哪些？
cases.reference_sql: SELECT p.product_name,ROUND(SUM(oi.item_amount),2) AS sales_amount FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id=oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') AND o.order_date>='2026-08-01' AND o.order_date<'2026-09-01' GROUP BY p.product_id,p.product_name ORDER BY sales_amount DESC,p.product_id ASC LIMIT 5

cases.question: 以2026年9月12日为今天，最近30天消费金额最高的5个客户是谁？返回用户ID、姓名和消费金额。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT u.user_id,u.user_name,ROUND(SUM(o.paid_amount),2) AS sales_amount FROM users u JOIN orders o ON u.user_id=o.user_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') AND o.order_date>=DATE_SUB('2026-09-12',INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY u.user_id,u.user_name ORDER BY sales_amount DESC,u.user_id ASC LIMIT 5
cases.note: Existing contract has only the DATE_SUB lower bound. An extra upper bound changes results in this dataset; report separately, do not modify engine or contract.
